help.password_reset_free_per_hour: How many individual resets an operator can do per hour without typing their password; past the limit it is required. 0 = always required.
help.password_reset_expiration_hours: After this period an unchanged temporary password stops working and the account must be reset again.
help.password_reset_enabled: Off by default in production: turn it on only during the agreed window to reset passwords and turn it off afterwards.
help.impersonation_max_minutes: After this time the session ends on its own and is not renewed.
help.impersonation_alert_sessions_per_day: Above this number of sessions in a day, superadmins receive a security alert.
help.impersonation_alert_targets_per_hour: Viewing more distinct people than this in an hour sends superadmins a security alert.
help.impersonation_alert_blocked_writes_per_s: Above this number of blocked write attempts within a single session, superadmins receive a security alert (a sign of a script).

labels.impersonation_alert_sessions_per_day: Alert: View as sessions per superadmin per day
labels.impersonation_alert_targets_per_hour: Alert: distinct people viewed per hour
labels.impersonation_alert_blocked_writes_per_s: Alert: blocked writes per View as session

approversTab.title: Substitute approvers
approversTab.subtitle: Besides each module's primary approver, these accounts can decide the same things (credit notes, voids, purchase orders, inventory adjustments, petty cash, cash counts and commissions) when the primary approver is away. Superadmin only.
approversTab.empty: No substitutes: only the primary approver decides.
